d:
Cardiff, 71,669 people, and a Rugby World Cup Semi-Final on the line... When the roaring fans arrived at the Millennium Stadium they expected to see the superstar All Blacks - helmed by Richie McCaw and Dan Carter - book their spot against England, but Les Bleus had other ideas. The night begun with an unforgettable Haka standoff, preceded by 60 minutes of tense back-and-forth rugby - before a magical 20 minutes that saw France do the unthinkable...
